blurb: Maple Meadows Equestrian Centre offers training and coaching primarily for serious intermediate and advanced level riders. The centre features professional coaches with extensive competition experience and recognized judging credentials. They focus on hunter, jumper, and equitation disciplines and support rider development through the show season from May through October.
